notes.title: Version 2.0! - New enemy, leaderboard and achievements.
notes.content:
I've updated the game to include a new spider enemy, a leaderboard for furthest distance and also some achievements.

Here is a picture of the spider:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33505218/843e45cf66e2ac542ec1797dd0d82ef6f7e0b73a.png[/img]

I've also made some improvements on the back end to improve the accuracy of collisions.

Oh, also clouds. I added clouds to the background because it felt a little dull before. 

To celebrate this, I'm going to discount the game by 20% for a week.

If you have any suggestions, feedback or find any bugs, feel free to post it in the Steam discussions so I can look into it.

Thanks for playing Type Fighter,
Simon.
